Name: Witchy Crystal Farm
Author: wrennybirdy
Description:
Hey, this is a reboot of my first farm map and I made it to go along with my witchy theme! Enjoy :)

Replaces standard farm by default, but the values can be changed in the content.json of the [CP] Witchy Crystal Farm folder.

It uses Farm Type Manager for the quarry and foraging locations, and TMXL Map Toolkit for the warp patches due to the size of the farm. If you want the specific log foraging locations, you will need to start a new farm, unfortunately, but if I find a way around it I will update. In the meantime, you can switch the FindExistingObjectLocations value to false. 

It also uses the unofficial Teh Pers Fishing Overhaul patch to make the water fishable! (Except for the lake in the middle, that is not fishable because it's swimmable and can't be both :/)

You need to walk behind the bush by the staircase into the lake to change into your swimsuit so you can swim properly!

Added an optional download with more plots to make up for all tiles not being tillable. You need to first download the main file and then replace the [CP] Witchy Crystal Farm folder with the one in the optional download. 

For mac/linux compatibility, these file renames are needed for it to work:
- Fall_Waterfall_Cave.png to fall_Waterfall_Cave.png
- Spring_Waterfall_Cave.png to spring_Waterfall_Cave.png
- Summer_Waterfall_Cave.png to summer_Waterfall_Cave.png
- Winter_Waterfall_Cave.png to winter_Waterfall_Cave.png
Thanks to kdau for bringing this to my attention!

Thanks to the stardew valley modding discord and especially [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/51777556]minervamaga[/url] for helping me make my farm and troubleshoot!

Feel free to edit this farm and upload here on nexus mods, just please link back to this page, and make sure to link all of the assets I used! Thank you! I will not be editing this mod any longer because I don't have the time or energy and I'm not really into Stardew Valley anymore, but I want you all to still enjoy it and make any edits you want.

Uses assets from [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/843]2cute farm cave[/url]﻿, [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3505]Froststar11's Underground Fairy Spring[/url], [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2380]Tanpoponoko's Custom Map Elements[/url]﻿, [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/891/]Eemie's Flowers[/url]﻿, [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1515]Witchy Decorations[/url], [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2777]Yellog Pet House Reskin[/url]﻿, [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1293]White Water Farm Map[/url]﻿, [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/rues-creepy-curios-and-spooky-aesthetics-updated-11-7.126419/]Rue's Creepy Curios[/url], [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/waterfall-tilesheet-w-animation.132102/page-2]Maleha's waterfalls[/url], [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1259]Eemie's Bees[/url]﻿, and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1111]Mi's and Eemie's Butterflies[/url]﻿.

Compatible with all recolors!
